verdict.rationale: Modal provides a documented Python SDK (plus JS/Go SDKs) with docs for sandbox lifecycle, filesystem, networking, snapshots, and CLI, and community developers have used gRPC/SDK to programmatically control sandboxes from agent runtimes. However, there's no formal OpenAPI/REST spec (probe found 404s on all candidate paths), so 'documented public API' is really SDK/CLI-level rather than a fully specified public API surface. missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/REST API spec, comprehensive API reference docs beyond guides/CLI, and broader independent corroboration of API completeness/stability.
